_comment: Single source of profile -> model endpoints for bench.sh / benchmark.yml (spec-benchmark-ci). Shape mirrors Komplyt's ModelEndpointConfig (src/lib/ai/resolve-model.ts): a provider name resolved through a registry, a model id, an optional endpoint (base_url), and the API key as an attribute taken from the env var the registry names. Adding a provider = one entry in `providers` plus the matching env var / CI secret; nothing in the scripts names a provider. Prices are LIST prices per 1M tokens in USD as recorded on prices_recorded_on; verify before quoting. Judge is gpt-5 in every profile so results share one scale.

cheap.comment: Direction only: cheapest legs, same judge.

head-to-head.comment: Everything gpt-5; comparable to mem0's published Cloud runs in model class.

small-model.comment: Small-model profile: adds the no-memory full-context floor. mem0 OSS's default container config is OpenAI-only; running its extraction on an Anthropic model needs an Anthropic-capable mem0 config (llm.provider: anthropic + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the container), see docker/mem0 and configs/.

prices_note: List prices per 1M tokens, USD, as published on the providers' pricing pages on prices_recorded_on. Not verified against invoices. cached_input_per_m_usd null = provider offers no prompt cache discount we can rely on.
